plugins.name: blackpaw-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code — pairing, allowlists, groups with mention-triggers, photo inbox; voice transcription, document ingest, inline keyboards, and scheduled reminders land in upcoming releases.

plugins.name: rich-statusline
plugins.description: Multi-row status dashboard under the prompt: model and effort, path, git branch with diff stats and PR, context window by category, 5-hour and weekly limits, and cost, in three layouts with a settings menu above the prompt.
